by.quote: c3_0311 "The sleeve in the corner of the second photo." FLAT (explains itself). Akane's "Both of them." has already pointed at the 0310 plant. Two pointers in a row connect the dots for the reader. Keep one.

items.why: Only the sleeve-clue pointer on the photo is flagged; no check says the photo routine reads as Kōhei controlling Akane (readers called it cute).

by.quote: c3_0392 kohei: "Back there. You didn't take the picture." CUT (explains itself; check the outline). 0388 already landed "She doesn't take the shot." Pointing at it turns a quiet image into a flagged mystery. ... Cut the untaken-photo exchange (0392–0393) unless the outline calls for it. The narration already landed it, and her cover story makes a quiet image into a flagged mystery and a new signal.

Natsuki's camera is aimed at the branch the moment before the light appears under it ... With her lens on the branch one beat before the light shows up under it, a reader can conclude that she saw it too. ... Fix: aim the camera at Kōhei only

items.why: Diagnosis cuts the camera exchange as an over-flagged clue; continuity calls the 0388 aim an extra signal but keeps the beat; all three readers praised the untaken shot.

by.quote: c3_0080 "It lands somewhere I wasn't guarding." FLAT (vouches; low priority). It tells us 0079 hit. The line is strong enough on its own, and a physical beat would do more.

items.why: Same line, narration states what the scene already showed (on the nose); readers 1 and 3 praised it.

by.quote: iPad: in the window CGs, the text box and Kōhei's face window hide the rabbit, so the narration describes things the player can't see ... Nanoha's folded arms are also under the box. ... Outpaint wall below the window, or move the composition up and right

items.why: Build finds the iPad text box covering the lower part of all three window CGs (down to her arms under her chin); its fix of moving the composition up is the author's fix, though it never names her face.
No check raised recall dependence; diagnosis lists 'It's trash bags.' among the chapter's best lines.
Diagnosis keeps 0341-0366; no reader or check flagged the bridge callback needing Ch2 fresh.

by.quote: Kōhei only laughs out loud with Natsuki (the chair at the restaurant, "I laugh before I can decide not to," "this time I can't stop laughing," the photo). It's a clear signal, but placed so regularly it starts to feel mechanical.
Kōhei laughs "before I can decide not to" (or a version of it) in nearly every Natsuki scene. It's turning into a tic.

items.why: Readers point at the line only as a repeated laugh beat, not at its edgy tone.

by.quote: c3_0359 and c3_0365: "She lifts the camera" and "pulled the camera back against her chest with both hands". The sprite holds the camera at her waist with one hand.

items.why: Build flags a text/sprite mismatch on the line, not that the wording is unclear.

by.quote: c3_0400 "She sounds delighted." FLAT (vouches). It's a tone tag. The line and the curious face already show it.

"Just stopping for a rest." / "Looks like rain tomorrow." Intriguing, but completely opaque. Readers who don't know the superstition about stumbling on shrine steps get nothing, and Kōhei "never once asked."

items.why: Findings touch the exchange but name a tone tag and the ritual's deliberate opacity, not the 'it'-as-rain misreading; readers 2 and 3 praised the ritual.

by.quote: Also in image_15, Nanoha (hair long and loose, no braid or clip, cream sweater) doesn't read as the Nanoha from image_04/10. She looks older and taller.

items.why: Reader 2 mentions her cream top only as part of Nanoha being unrecognizable; onmodel noted both girls' cream cardigans and passed them; nobody says the outfits are too alike.
Onmodel, build and continuity all checked the lunch seating and passed it; continuity #9 shares c3_0413 but is about Kazuo's job.

liked.note: Unflagged by the independent check: each quote is a line-level note inside the scene (two of them are lines the author flagged himself); none says the scene doesn't work.
